name: Adelaide Deep Seat Sofa
shortDescription: Deep, generous seating with a hardwood frame and a weave that survives real life.
description:
The Adelaide Deep Seat Sofa was drawn in our Adelaide studio and made to be lived with. Every join is cut, sanded and finished by hand, then checked twice before it leaves the workshop — so the piece that arrives is the piece we would put in our own homes.

Materials. Kiln-dried oak frame, performance boucle. We source from suppliers who can tell us where the timber grew, and we finish with low-VOC oils that let the grain keep moving and breathing over the years.

Proportions. 240 x 98 x 84 cm. Measure your doorways and lift before ordering — our team is happy to talk you through access if the piece is going upstairs.

Care. Dust with a dry, soft cloth. Blot spills straight away rather than rubbing. Keep out of direct afternoon sun to stop the finish from fading unevenly.

Backed by our 10-year frame warranty and a 30-day at-home trial. If it is not right in your room, we will collect it and refund you in full.
